extracted.intended_audience: professional and student broadcast and digital journalists and news organizations considering entry to the 2026 Edward R. Murrow Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility information for submitting entries to the 2026 Edward R. Murrow Awards, including publication-date eligibility, deadlines, categories (professional and student; broadcast and digital), and the core evaluation principles (ethics, technical expertise, community impact).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication-date eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: To be eligible, work must have been published between Jan. 1, 2025, and Dec. 31, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only work with publication dates within the specified window will be considered eligible for 2026 entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entry deadlines and early-bird timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Early Bird Discount for entries submitted by 5 p.m. on Tuesday, Jan. 20. The final entry deadline is 5 p.m. Thursday, Feb. 19.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit by the stated deadlines to qualify for Early Bird pricing and to be accepted; times are given in local/site-specified timezone (as posted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Read complete rules and category descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Entrants are strongly encouraged to read the complete rules and category descriptions prior to submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the full rules and category descriptions linked on the site to ensure correct category placement, compliance with submission requirements, and understanding of judging criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible formats and entry levels
rubrics_metrics.description: The Murrow Awards recognize outstanding achievements in both professional and student-level broadcast and digital journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries may be in broadcast or digital formats and must be submitted in the appropriate professional or student category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of work (local and national news)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Murrow Awards recognize local and national news stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both locally focused reporting and nationally focused reporting are within scope; entrants should choose the category that matches their story's reach and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uphold the RTDNA Code of Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: The Murrow Awards recognize news stories that uphold the RTDNA Code of Ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries are expected to adhere to RTDNA ethical standards (see RTDNA Code of Ethics for specifics); ethical practice is an explicit evaluation dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstrate technical expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Murrow entries should demonstrate technical expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judges will consider the technical quality of the work (production, audio/video editing, presentation) as part of evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exemplify the importance and impact of journalism as a service to the community
rubrics_metrics.description: The Murrow Awards recognize work that exemplifies the importance and impact of journalism as a service to the community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries should show how the reporting served the community, contributed to public understanding, or produced demonstrable impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard of excellence associated with Edward R. Murrow
rubrics_metrics.description: Murrow Award-winning work demonstrates the excellence that Edward R. Murrow made a standard for the broadcast news profession.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judges look for work reflecting high standards of journalistic excellence, consistent with the legacy and expectations associated with the Murrow Awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional winners advance to national competition
rubrics_metrics.description: Regional winners will be announced in the Spring during #MurrowMay. All regional winners automatically advance to the national competition, which will be announced in August.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitting organizations/individuals should be aware of the multi-stage selection process and associated timelines; national winners are celebrated at the awards gala (date/location provided).
